description: Default capabilities for SoftN Loader (desktop): only what the page calls. Its own commands are the app's (lib.rs); of Tauri's it listens for and emits events (the drop listener, XDB's native events) and sets the window's title. `core:default` granted it the image, menu, path, tray, resources and window APIs besides, among them reading an image from any path, a UNC share's included.
